name: Gilla
summary:
Gilla is a multiplayer VR horror game in which you play as an ape, pushing off the floor and walls with your arms to run, climb and leap. You explore a huge abandoned base alongside other players, hunting for gold bars and diamonds to carry back to the recycler while monsters roam the halls, drawn to the sound of voices on the live voice chat, and a keycard opens the locked door to the levels underneath.

Other modes turn one player into the monster to hunt everyone else for two minutes, or send players across platforms that sink into flooded water patrolled by a shark that grows faster every round.
